hook: You breathe mostly through one nostril
caption:
Right now, one of your nostrils is doing most of the breathing. Tissue inside your nose swells on one side and shrinks on the other, and the roles swap every few hours. It's called the nasal cycle, and most people never notice it.

Your autonomic nervous system runs it automatically, the same system that controls your heartbeat. Lying on your side also tends to congest the lower nostril. Follow for one body fact your brain won't believe, every day.

Cover one nostril, then the other: which one is winning right now?
